items.label: Current office
items.text: California Secretary of State; sworn in January 29, 2021 after nomination by Governor Newsom and legislative confirmation; elected to a full term November 8, 2022. (sources: California Secretary of State https://www.sos.ca.gov/administration/about [search summary, primary]; California Secretary of State https://www.sos.ca.gov/administration/news-releases-and-advisories/2021-news-releases-and-advisories/sw21001 [search summary, primary])

items.label: Offices held
items.text: Member, California State Assembly (District 79), first elected 2012, served four terms, including as chair of the Assembly Budget Committee; California Secretary of State, 2021–present. (sources: California State Archives https://exhibits.sos.ca.gov/s/breaking-barriers-african-americans/page/aasc-22 [search summary, primary]; California Secretary of State https://www.sos.ca.gov/administration/about [search summary, primary])

items.label: Academic career
items.text: Faculty member in the Department of Africana Studies at San Diego State University for about 40 years, including several terms as department chair. (sources: California Secretary of State https://www.sos.ca.gov/administration/news-releases-and-advisories/2021-news-releases-and-advisories/sw21001 [search summary, primary])

items.label: Education
items.text: Bachelor's, master's and Ph.D. degrees, University of California, Los Angeles. (sources: California Secretary of State https://www.sos.ca.gov/administration/about [search summary, primary])

items.label: Birth year
items.text: Born in 1948. (sources: California State Archives https://exhibits.sos.ca.gov/s/breaking-barriers-african-americans/page/aasc-22 [search summary, primary])

items.label: Birthplace
items.text: Born in Hope, Arkansas; family moved to California when she was about three. (sources: California State Archives https://exhibits.sos.ca.gov/s/breaking-barriers-african-americans/page/aasc-22 [search summary, primary]; California Secretary of State https://www.sos.ca.gov/administration/about [search summary, primary])

items.label: Current office
items.text: Member, Orange County Board of Supervisors (Third District), first elected in a 2019 special election and re-elected in 2020 and 2024; board chairman since 2023. (sources: Orange County Board of Supervisors, Third District https://bos3.oc.gov/supervisor [search summary, primary])

items.label: Previous offices
items.text: Trustee, South Orange County Community College District, first elected 1998, three terms; Member, California State Assembly, six years (exact years not confirmed by sources seen); Mayor of Irvine (in office in 2018). (sources: CalOptima https://caloptima.org/en/About/AboutCalOptima/BoardOfDirectors/DonWagner [search summary, primary]; Voice of OC https://voiceofoc.org/2018/12/don-wagner-launches-campaign-for-orange-county-supervisor/ [search summary, secondary]; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Donald_P._Wagner [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Legal career
items.text: Business attorney at a Los Angeles/Orange County law firm from 1987; started his own law firm in 1993. (sources: Orange County Board of Supervisors, Third District https://bos3.oc.gov/supervisor [search summary, primary]; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Donald_P._Wagner [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Education
items.text: Law degree, University of California, Hastings College of the Law (per Wikipedia). His official materials describe a UCLA affiliation but the sources seen do not state a degree or year. (sources: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Donald_P._Wagner [search summary, secondary]; Orange County Board of Supervisors, Third District https://bos3.oc.gov/supervisor [search summary, primary])
